verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that BugSnag's self-hosted MCP server supports OAuth 2.0 browser-based login as an alternative to manual API tokens, so agents have a dedicated credential path. Nothing shows those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. missing for 10: documented per-token scopes/permissions, read-only or project-limited agent credentials, token management/revocation docs, independent corroboration.
